This hearing has been done through hybrid mode.
2. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.
3. The present application under Section 483 of the BNSS/439 of the Cr.P.C. seeks regular bail in case FIR No.630/2022, under Sections 376/379/506/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Prasad Nagar.
4. Issue notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks some time to file a status report.
Let the same be filed before the next date of hearing, with an advance copy to learned counsel for the applicant.
This is a digitally signed order.
